# Generated by make_gnostic_estate_buildings.py from jip_mishpacha_estate_buildings.txt: the Sabian and Mandaean
# families' estate branches. Rerun after changing the Jewish branches.

# Diwan sub-branch of the Familial office, beside the Clerk's Office: the chancery where the Sabian secretaries of
# Baghdad learned their trade. A copy of the Beit Din.
jip_diwan_03 = {
	construction_time = 730
	allowed_domicile_types = { estate }
	slot_type = internal
	previous_building = jip_office_02

	can_construct_potential = {
		jip_can_build_sabian_estate_building_trigger = yes
	}
	can_construct = {
		domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = estate_main_02 }
	}

	cost = {
		gold = {
			value = estate_internal_building_normal_cost_tier_3_value
		}
	}

	parameters = {
		jip_estate_diwan_1 = yes
	}

	character_modifier = {
		legitimacy_gain_mult = 0.1
		dynasty_opinion = 5
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = 15
		add = estate_building_ai_modifier_value
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/jip_domicile_building_diwan.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/estate_building_villa_byzantine.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/estate_building_villa_byzantine_mask.png"
	}
}

# Haykal sub-branch of the Familial temple, beside the Crypt: a shrine of the seven planets, as the Sabians of Harran
# kept them. A copy of the Beit Knesset without its ties and expulsion effects, which are Jewish.
jip_haykal_04 = {
	construction_time = 730
	allowed_domicile_types = { estate }
	previous_building = jip_temple_small_03

	can_construct_potential = {
		jip_can_build_sabian_estate_building_trigger = yes
	}
	can_construct = {
		domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = estate_main_03 }
	}

	cost = {
		gold = {
			value = estate_external_building_normal_cost_tier_4_value
			if = {
				limit = { has_character_modifier = raid_insight_temple }
				multiply = 0.75
				desc = raid_insight_temple
			}
		}
	}

	parameters = {
		jip_estate_haykal_1 = yes
	}

	character_modifier = {
		domicile_monthly_piety_add = 0.2
		dualism_religion_opinion = 5
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = 16
		add = estate_building_ai_modifier_value
	}

	asset = {
		trigger = {
			domicile_location.culture = {
				OR = {
					has_graphical_iranian_culture_group_trigger = yes
					has_graphical_mena_culture_group_trigger = yes
					has_graphical_steppe_culture_group_trigger = yes
					has_graphical_african_culture_group_trigger = yes
					has_graphical_india_culture_group_trigger = yes
					has_graphical_iberian_culture_group_trigger = yes
				}
			}
		}
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/jip_domicile_building_haykal.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/estate_building_temple_generic_mena.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/estate_building_temple_generic_mask.png"
		soundeffect = "event:/DLC/EP3/SFX/UI/domicile_buildings/ep3_ui_domicile_buildings_temple_large"
	}
	asset = {
		trigger = {
			domicile_location.culture = {
				OR = {
					has_graphical_western_culture_group_trigger = yes
					has_graphical_norse_culture_group_trigger = yes
				}
			}
		}
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/jip_domicile_building_haykal.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/estate_building_temple_generic_western.dds"

# Scriptorium sub-branch of the library, beside the Observatory and the Tutor's Office, where the Ginza Rabba and the
# Mandaean books are copied. A copy of the Yeshiva.
jip_scriptorium_03 = {
	construction_time = 730
	allowed_domicile_types = { estate }
	slot_type = internal
	previous_building = library_02

	can_construct_potential = {
		jip_can_build_mandaean_estate_building_trigger = yes
	}
	can_construct = {
		domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = estate_main_02 }
	}

	cost = {
		gold = {
			value = estate_internal_building_normal_cost_tier_3_value
			if = {
				limit = { has_character_modifier = raid_insight_library }
				multiply = 0.75
				desc = raid_insight_library
			}
		}
	}

	parameters = {
		estate_increase_physician_aptitude_3 = yes
		estate_increased_tutor_aptitude_2 = yes
		jip_estate_scriptorium_1 = yes
	}

	character_modifier = {
		monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.05
		domicile_monthly_piety_add = 0.2
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = 15
		add = estate_building_ai_modifier_value
	}

	asset = {
		icon = "gfx/interface/icons/domicile_building/jip_domicile_building_scriptorium.dds"
		texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/estate_building_villa_byzantine.dds"
		intersectionmask_texture = "gfx/interface/window_domiciles/estate_building_villa_byzantine_mask.png"
	}
}
